name: Chester County, PA
findings: Chester County has 2,378 nonprofit organizations. 1,130 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 898 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Chester County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
